title: Smooth maps onto regions in Euclidean spaces respecting height functions
summary: One of interest of the author lies in the canonical projections of the unit spheres and generalizations. He is interested in the canonical projections of embedded manifolds in the higher dimensional Euclidean spaces, including height functions, especially, their construction and representations by explicit equations. This is a kind of fundamental studies on construction or global theory on singularity theory of differentiable maps, closely related to differential geometry, differential topology, and algebraic geometry.
